title: Report: FTC probes Anthropic, OpenAI after Trump dismissed AI fears as “hoax”
script:
The FTC is investigating OpenAI and Anthropic over potential security failures.
Regulators want to know if security incidents actually harmed American users.
This follows President Trump's recent dismissal of AI risks as a hoax.
The FTC may fine these labs for failing to report data breaches.
The FTC is demanding internal safety logs to assess compliance.
OpenAI and Anthropic now face heightened scrutiny from federal regulators.
Are you comfortable with these labs handling your private data?

editor.one_line: Weak hook and repetitive, low-quality visuals fail to meet premium news standards.
script_fixes: LINE 1: Start with the specific threat: 'The FTC is investigating OpenAI and Anthropic for potential data breach reporting failures.'
LINE 3: Remove the political commentary; replace with: 'The probe follows recent FTC warnings that AI firms must meet the same data security standards as other tech giants.'
LINE 7: Replace with a specific call to action: 'Will these new FTC fines force a change in how AI labs secure your data?'

line 2: The stock photo of a child is unrelated to the technical subject of data breaches.
line 6: The abstract gradient background is filler and lacks visual information.
